verdict.rationale: Skills for Real Engineers is a bundle of agent skills and could plausibly ship event hooks, so this axis applies. The evidence only shows skills invoked by slash command or picked by the agent from their descriptions (e.g., 'Use when the user wants...'), plus a triage state machine the agent runs on request. Nothing documents user-defined rules that fire actions automatically on events, so these are adjacent behaviors, not the requested capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
